# Dang Pham — Product & Visual Designer

> Product and Visual Designer in Ho Chi Minh City working across B2B SaaS product UI, e-commerce operations and creative systems, visual design, motion, and AI-assisted image/video workflows.

## Portfolio
- [Selected work and professional experience](/)
- [Full work archive](/work)

## Independent Projects
- [Northstar RevOps](/projects/northstar-revops) — self-directed B2B SaaS revenue-operations concept covering forecasting, risk triage, dense data and deal-level workflows.
- [ReturnFlow Ops](/projects/returnflow-ops) — self-directed e-commerce operations concept covering return queues, refund exposure, SLA risk and approval decisions.
- [AdForge Creative Ops](/projects/adforge-creative-ops) — self-directed AI creative-operations concept with structured generation, human review and production handoff.
- [Thiên Kim](/projects/thien-kim) — virtual-character art direction and repeatable AI image/video workflow covering continuity, shot planning, execution routing and QC.

## Capabilities
- Product & Web: Figma, responsive UI, data-dense dashboards, operational workflows, design systems and developer handoff.
- Visual & Graphic: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, digital/web visual design, e-commerce and promotional assets, typography/layout.
- Motion & 3D: After Effects, Premiere Pro, Blender, UI motion and 3D animation.
- AI Image & Video: character-consistency workflows, image-to-video direction, short-form shot planning and AI-assisted creative production.

## Source Policy
Public visual work is linked to the original Dribbble source where available. Self-directed concepts are labeled as concepts and link to live interactive prototypes. The portfolio avoids invented client names, campaign outcomes, KPIs and unverified performance claims.
